page.layout: One column of index lines, running down the page; marginal catchwords "ordine" and "moderatione" at the right, beside lines 3 and 4; a printer's ornament and the number 2 at the foot.

main_text.l: De lege amoris conjugalis : qui sese exserit
De mutuo conjugum honore in castitate
3. Vxor sub viri esto potestate : hic illi dominator. ordine
Quare viri bellatores feré sint uxorii?
Mariti in uxorem imperium quale esse debeat?
4. Nimius conjugum amor maturè expellendus, moderatione
antequam bestia instar dentes & ungues producat: qui sunt,
Qui populi zelotypiæ morbo sint obnoxii?

page.notes: Printer's ornament ")(:( )" above the page number is decorative and not transcribed. The Greek word on the line beginning "Γυναικοκρατίας" is uncertain and marked [?]. Marginal catchwords "ordine" and "moderatione" are shown as printed, with their flourishes omitted. The line "Quare fœminæ velentur capite" is printed as "velentur".
